objective: Make the Crown Control Room a read-only projection of Royal Exchange records, with no live reads from Task Index, GitHub, Brain, account, services or release APIs.
why: The Control Room must report creator intent and execution evidence without becoming a second authority or silently substituting live state from other owners.
nonGoals: Do not mutate Task Index or mission/task lifecycle from the UI.
Do not query external services, Brain context, GitHub, deployment metadata or release APIs at runtime.
Do not infer production completion from a plan, work order, commit or partial receipt.
Do not add write controls, deployment controls, OAuth scope changes, billing changes or publishing actions.
acceptance: Every displayed mission, task reference, artifact, decision, work order, receipt, conflict and handoff is derived from JSON records under .viewtube/exchange/**.
Today, Code, Services, Brain and Release panels do not query non-Exchange runtime sources.
Missing evidence is presented as unknown or missing and never synthesized as success.
A mission is not displayed as complete without a complete receipt.
The generator rejects malformed JSON and an Exchange without mission records.
The generator contract tests and production build pass.
rollback: Revert the Crown Control Room feature branch; preserve all pre-existing Royal Exchange records and canonical authorities.
